2. analyze_functional_groups(smiles: string)

6. remove_salts(smiles: string)
   Strip salts and counterions, keeping the largest organic fragment. Use when SMILES contains '.' separators.

7. predict_metabolites(smiles: string)
   Predict top CYP450 metabolites (Phase 1 and Phase 2) with reaction types and priority scores.

8. get_3d_properties(smiles: string)
   Compute 3D conformer properties: exposed polar surface area (ePSA) and shape (PMI rod/disc/sphere).

9. find_similar_molecules_pgp(smiles: string)
